scripts.dev:fresh: npm run dev:clean && npm run dev
scripts.dev:python-ai: cd services/ai-service && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.lint:python-ai: cd services/ai-service && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format:python-ai: cd services/ai-service && uv run ruff format .
scripts.ml:python-sample: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m training.generate_sample_data
scripts.ml:python-validate: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m training.validate_dataset
scripts.ml:python-train: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m training.train_recommendations
scripts.ml:python-export: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m training.export_catalog --output datasets/exports/products.jsonl
scripts.ml:python-batch: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m app.ml.inference.batch
scripts.ml:python-publish: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m training.publish_snapshot
scripts.ml:python-diagnose: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m evaluation.catalog_diagnostics
scripts.ml:python-eval: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m evaluation.evaluate_recommendations
scripts.ml:behavioral-sample: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m training.generate_behavioral_data
scripts.ml:behavioral-validate: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m training.validate_behavioral_dataset --dataset datasets/synthetic/behavioral_events.jsonl
scripts.ml:behavioral-train: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m training.train_collaborative --events datasets/synthetic/behavioral_events.jsonl --catalog datasets/synthetic/behavioral_products.jsonl --min-product-interactions 1
scripts.ml:behavioral-hybrid: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m training.configure_hybrid
scripts.ml:behavioral-eval: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m evaluation.evaluate_behavioral --events datasets/synthetic/behavioral_events.jsonl --catalog datasets/synthetic/behavioral_products.jsonl --output evaluation/reports/behavioral.json
scripts.ml:neural-train: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m training.train_neural --events datasets/synthetic/behavioral_events.jsonl --catalog datasets/synthetic/behavioral_products.jsonl --epochs 12 --device cpu
scripts.ml:neural-eval: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m evaluation.evaluate_behavioral --events datasets/synthetic/behavioral_events.jsonl --catalog datasets/synthetic/behavioral_products.jsonl --output evaluation/reports/behavioral-neural.json
scripts.ml:neural-infer: cd services/ai-service && uv run python -m app.ml.inference.neural_cli --product-id hp-1 --top-k 3
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:mobile
scripts.test:notifications: vitest run convex/lib/orderNotificationLogic.test.ts convex/lib/notificationRetention.test.ts convex/lib/inAppNotificationPersistence.test.ts convex/lib/pushTokenSelection.test.ts convex/lib/orderCancellation.test.ts convex/lib/orderReceipt.test.ts convex/lib/orderReorder.test.ts convex/lib/inventory.test.ts convex/lib/stripeRefund.test.ts convex/lib/adminOrderTransitions.test.ts convex/lib/orderLifecycle.test.ts convex/lib/cancellationFee.test.ts convex/lib/orderSms.test.ts
scripts.test:qr: vitest run convex/lib/qrCodes.test.ts convex/lib/siteUrl.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.mobile.config.ts apps/mobile/lib/qr-links.test.ts apps/mobile/lib/qr-deep-links.test.ts apps/mobile/lib/order-receipt-qr.test.ts apps/mobile/lib/notification-navigation.test.ts
